notes.title: Major Update #4 | New Symbols, Scares, Locations, and Huge Gameplay Changes!
notes.content:
[quote][b]Your Experience[/b]
If you are enjoying the game and haven't yet left your feedback via a Steam Review, would you consider letting others know about your experience? Reviews are super important for small developers like us, and we truly appreciate your support.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/2497900]https://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/2497900[/url][/quote]
[b]Why hello there, Screamers![/b]

It’s been a little while since our last update, and this one brings some of the most significant changes yet. We’ve listened closely to your feedback, fixed a ton of issues, and introduced new features that should make DON’T SCREAM scarier, fairer, and more replayable than ever.

[b]DON'T SCREAM is now 25% off as part of Steam's Daily Deal. Spread the word to your friends![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2497900/DONT_SCREAM/
Encountered bugs or have feedback? Connect with us on our[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2497900/discussions/2/] Steam Forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/TGBR58KPjB]Discord[/url]. Thank you!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/TGBR58KPjB][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/1f980cfbe5ef8dc8e1511f846f10dde1e4100a68.png[/img][/url]

[u][h3]PLEASE NOTE: TRANSLATION HOTFIX INCOMING ASAP![/h3][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/0da9482154d4a453840a078030b1b076bd2f2365.jpg[/img]
One of the biggest additions in this update is the introduction of [b]Symbols[/b]. The arrow marker now points you towards an unknown location in the forest, but it is up to you to search that area and find the symbols themselves. This creates clear objectives without revealing everything, and it heightens the tension, since focusing on a symbol can leave you exposed if you are not careful. Of course, it's still vital to find batteries and keep your camcorder powered!

We also made important adjustments to [b]traps[/b]. They should be dangerous, but we know they were previously too hard to see. We added a camcorder-style glitch effect that fits the game’s look and makes traps easier to spot without removing the surprise.

Another major change is [b]full controller support[/b]. Menus, interface, and gameplay now work cleanly on a controller, with improved icons for different controller types. If you prefer to play from the couch, the experience should feel much smoother.

We have also changed how time is shown in the game. The original HUD used an 18-minute countdown that only ticked when you moved. That countdown is gone. You now start at 15 : 46 : 37 and the HUD shows the in-game world clock, still advancing only when you move, until you reach 08:00 and escape the forest. Under the hood, it is still 18 minutes, but this presentation makes scares less predictable and the atmosphere much tenser. Taking away the countdown keeps you from waiting for the end and makes every step feel more unpredictable.

Alongside new content, we also wanted to address one of the biggest discussions from the last major update: the Hunters. Not everyone enjoyed the Hunters we introduced, so we added an option to remove them completely. This leaves the scares, batteries, and environmental traps as the core challenge. At the same time, we expanded this idea into new modes and options that give you more control over how you experience the game. [b]Atmospheric Mode[/b] focuses on sound and mood with fewer direct scares, [b]Chaos Mode[/b] delivers completely unpredictable frights, and custom intensity rules let you set the overall length of a playthrough. These additions give you more freedom to tailor the game to your own style of horror.

We’ll stop here, but this update goes further. Alongside these highlights, you’ll find lots of other small and big changes, fresh scares, and improvements across performance, readability, and stability. The full notes are below.

Oh, and yes, there are a lot more locations to find. I’ll just leave this one here... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/0073bfe3bbc4889894e1e60325ea063e08f194b5.jpg[/img]

[quote][b]PATCH NOTES[/b]
[h3][b]MAJOR CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] Atmospheric Mode: [i]Less in your face scares, more audio horrors and no Hunters[/i]
[*] [b]Added[/b] Chaos Mode: [i]No rules, just random scares with no build-up or suspense[/i]
[*] [b]Added[/b] No Hunters option: [i]Disable Hunters from spawning in the world[/i]
[*] [b]Added[/b] Custom game intensity rules for changing the length of play time
[*] [b]Added[/b] Unique Symbols to reveal forest secrets and unlock locations
[*] [b]Added[/b] Achievements to the in-game menu to better track progress
[*] [b]Added[/b] Better ending page showing new discoveries and game progress
[*] [b]Added[/b] Microphone calibration screen to make setup easier
[*] [b]Added[/b] New locations with story snippets to find
[*] [b]Added[/b] Player power batteries at locations where you previously died
[*] [b]Added[/b] New locations: Castle Ruins, Abandoned Tower, The Pit, Greenhouse, and Hellscape
[*] [b]Added[/b] Restart button in the in-game menu to quickly start a new session with different rules
[*] [b]Added[/b] More trail markers and paths around the forest to help guide players
[*] [b]Added[/b] Full controller support (menus + gameplay; improved controls)
[*] [b]Added[/b] Many new scares — world, camera, creatures, and hunters
[*] [b]Added[/b] Day counter showing how many days you’ve been trapped in the forest

[*] [b]Improved[/b] Audio device support — more devices and better mic compatibility
[*] [b]Improved[/b] Tutorial for new players
[*] [b]Improved[/b] Hunters’ hearing when sprinting and not entering some interiors
[*] [b]Improved[/b] Controller icons for different controller types (PS & XB)
[*] [b]Improved[/b] Mic input peaks/dips to help prevent false-positive deaths
[*] [b]Improved[/b] Overall performance; DLSS & FSR updates
[*] [b]Improved[/b] Picking up batteries and symbols
[*] [b]Improved[/b] Trap visibility — traps now highlight in the dark

[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Many scares not showing properly or appearing where they shouldn’t
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] binding-key issues with controllers
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Numerous community-reported crash bugs
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Tape preview mode causing crashes or huge frame-rate drops
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] End-of-level screen not receiving inputs after alt-tabbing
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Cases where the menu wouldn’t show (e.g., when dying)
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Scroll menus for Locations and Relics to loop properly
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Blurry screen when picking up batteries and symbols
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Window-resolution changes not applying instantly
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Spots where players could get stuck or fall through the floor
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Loud bear voices when inside closed rooms
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Hunter animals sometimes not updating state while roaming
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Steam forcing a restart outside of the shipping build
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Crash in game state classes during tape preview
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] AudioThread not ticking audio commands while the game is paused
[/list][/quote]
Thanks for reading, and have a great weekend ahead! - [b]Joe[/b]
- Digital Cybercherries

notes.title: Welcome to 1.0 - MAJOR UPDATE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UmQHZf6m_YI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Hey, Screamers![/b]

Halloween is creeping up, and we've got a real treat for you. We're incredibly proud to announce that [b]DON'T SCREAM[/b] has officially launched out of early access and into its full [b]1.0[/b] release! We've been carefully reviewing all your feedback, and this update is packed with massive improvements, fixes, exciting changes, and terrifying new features! Everything, and we mean [i]everything[/i] about the game, has significantly improved.

A huge thank you to all of you who have helped us shape DON'T SCREAM into what it is now. We truly couldn't have done it without your incredible support and feedback!  The forest has undergone a serious transformation since your last visit, so let me walk you through some of the biggest changes: ([i]TL;DR version below[/i])

[quote]
[h3][b]TL;DR[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Vastly improved performance for smoother gameplay
[*] Enhanced scares with better models, animations, effects, and sounds
[*] Improved pacing of scares, with a greater focus on tension and buildup
[*] Each playthrough is much more dynamic - no two games will be the same!
[*] Dozens of new places to explore in the forest, and existing areas look much better
[*] Additional gameplay and graphics settings
[*] Completely redesigned sound for a more immersive experience (including binaural audio scares)
[*] Hugely improved microphone calibration
[*] Hunters can now kill the player
[*] New environmental dangers
[*] Relics to find to incentivise replayability
[*] Steam Trading Cards and Steam Achievements
[*] New battery mechanic to make things more challenging
[*] Completely overhauled user interface that's easier to use
[*] Progress page where players can track their discoveries
[*] Improved environmental storytelling
[*] Game now has much more replayability
[*] Added Arachnophobia mode to the Gameplay options
[*] Whispering or triggering sounds in the environment can alert nearby hunters
[*] Many fixes
[/list][/quote]

[h3]IMPROVED SCARES[/h3]
[*]We've put a tremendous amount of effort into making the game more focused on tension and suspense, rather than relying on constant jump scares. With the new "Scare Director" system, each playthrough is unique and far more dynamic.  Expect to be on the edge of your seat for the entire 18-minute experience. We've also enhanced the scare sequences with improved character models, animations, visual effects, and sounds!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mWJnpYK.gif[/img]

[h3]BATTERIES[/h3]
[*]To survive the night, you'll need to find batteries scattered throughout the environment. Batteries are used to discover new locations, encourage exploration, and provide a clear objective. However, we didn't want finding them to become frustrating. We've carefully balanced the number of available batteries with the need to stay vigilant about your power levels, creating a challenging yet rewarding experience.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VCONpqu.gif[/img]

[h3]HUNTERS[/h3]
[*]The forest is a living entity, and it's watching your every move...  Multiple enemy types now inhabit the woods, each with unique hunting styles. Some will stalk you from the shadows, others will charge with terrifying speed, and some might even do both! We won't spoil the surprises, but be prepared to encounter new threats... Remember, whispering or making noise can alert nearby hunters!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M0p3ido.gif[/img]

[h3]ENVIRONMENTAL DANGERS[/h3]
[*]Watch your step! The forest is riddled with hidden dangers that can end your journey in an instant.  Your voice isn't the only thing you need to worry about now...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IOcjOc4.gif[/img]

[h3]ENVIRONMENTAL STORYTELLING[/h3]
[*]One of the biggest takeaways from early access was the need for stronger environmental storytelling. We've built a world that draws you in and makes you question, "[i]What happened here[/i]?" This deeper level of immersion creates a greater sense of tension and intrigue as you explore the unsettling remnants of the forest's past.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ugrz9aP.gif[/img]

[h3]LOCATIONS[/h3]
[*]The forest has expanded significantly, with over 40 locations to discover. Each location has its own piece of history, which you can unlock and read about on the new Progress Page.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rj0INAo.gif[/img]

[h3]PROGRESS [/h3]
[*]A brand new Progress Page has been added to the game's UI, allowing you to track your discoveries, unlock lore entries, and monitor your overall progress.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NxB7DmY.gif[/img]

[h3]RELICS[/h3]
[*]To further enhance replayability, we've hidden relics throughout the forest. Find them all and uncover their lore on the Progress Page.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8SKE0jf.gif[/img]

[h3]USER INTERFACE[/h3]
[*]We've dedicated significant time to refining the user interface, ensuring it's both intuitive and still captures the classic feel of old-school VHS camera aesthetics, adding to the game's atmosphere.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TwVbnhi.gif[/img]

[h3]STAMINA[/h3]
[*]We've introduced a simple stamina mechanic to the game. Managing your stamina is can be crucial for survival, especially when hunters are nearby...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0uX71x8.gif[/img]

[h3]MICROPHONE CALIBRATION[/h3]
[*]Developing a game where the player's microphone is the core mechanic presents unique challenges. With countless microphone variations and software customizations, it's impossible to cater perfectly to every setup. However, we've invested considerable effort in improving the microphone calibration process. Our new "[i]automatic calibration[/i]" feature checks your microphone and adjusts the settings for optimal gameplay. You can still fine-tune the calibration manually, but we're confident that the automatic process will be accurate for most players.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IB9a1eF.gif[/img]

[h3]PERFORMANCE[/h3]
[*]We've made significant performance enhancements, particularly for those with lower-spec systems, making the game more accessible to a wider audience. We've also implemented DLSS (Nvidia) and FSR (AMD) technologies to boost frame rates and visual fidelity further.

[h3]SOUND[/h3]
[*]We've completely revamped the game's audio for a more realistic and terrifying experience. Every rustle of leaves, every snap of a twig, and every distant growl will have you thinking, "[i]what was that[/i]?"

[h3]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/h3]
[*]A variety of Steam achievements are now available, challenging you to complete specific tasks in-game. Yes, there's even an achievement for pushing over a scarecrow! See some of them below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/76c0174a12243caf2e97150a63ef467dcf613fc8.png[/img]

[h3]STEAM TRADING CARDS[/h3]
[*]No 1.0 release would be complete without Steam trading cards! These include badges, emoticons, and profile backgrounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/0aa1499ce0b472de344c723b4db97d626c1fbaf8.jpg[/img]

[h3]LOCATION SYSTEM[/h3]
[*]While we want you to somewhat experience the feeling of being lost in the woods, we also don't want you wandering aimlessly forever. A compass, arrow marker and coordinate system have been added to the in-game HUD to provide subtle guidance and encourage exploration. ([b]SEE TOP LEFT OF HUD[/b])

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YnhzNLd.gif[/img]

That's all for now! We hope you love this update. As always, we'll be keeping an eye out for any bugs and listening to your feedback. Thanks again, everyone!

Have fun, and remember, DON'T SCREAM! Warm regards - [b]Joe[/b]
- Digital Cybercherries

notes.title: Major Update #3 | Environment Overhaul - Part 2 + 20% OFF Steam Daily Deal!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Screamers![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/7b68983868326ee4a4261aabb5908c93f7b3f725.jpg[/img]

[i]Major Update #3[/i] is now live! As promised in our development roadmap, we're continuing to overhaul the environments. This update includes new locations, structures, and let's just say... some strange things! Once we're satisfied with the environmental additions, we'll focus on enhancing the finer details. Our goal is to make the forest and everything in it look realistic, weathered, and deteriorated. We want players to wonder, "Wait, what happened here?" and to keep you constantly on edge, always questioning your surroundings.

Before diving into the changelog, I want to address the current quality of scares. We know they aren’t where we want them to be just yet. Please remember, we're a small team of indie developers, and DON’T SCREAM is still in early access. By purchasing our game, you're not just buying into something early; you’re actively helping us refine it before the full release. Rest assured, all aspects of our scares—including models, animations, effects, and sounds—will be significantly enhanced or reworked. We’re taking a methodical approach to our updates, with upcoming ones set to focus more on improving these scares.

[b]DON'T SCREAM is now 20% off as part of Steam's Daily Deal. Spread the word to your friends![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2497900/DONT_SCREAM/

Encountered bugs or have feedback? Connect with us on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2497900/discussions/2/]Steam Forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/TGBR58KPjB]Discord[/url].  Thank you!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/TGBR58KPjB][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/1f980cfbe5ef8dc8e1511f846f10dde1e4100a68.png[/img]
[/url]
Here’s a recap of what’s planned in our development roadmap:

[quote][h3][u]DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Continue improving performance for smoother gameplay, especially optimizing for medium and high graphic settings.
[*] Significantly enhance scares, focusing on models, animations, effects, and sounds, and improving the tension and buildup of each scare.
[*] Introduce new objectives and more incentives to encourage exploration.
[*] Add new enemies that pose a real threat to the player—soon, your own scream won’t be the only thing to fear!
[*] Refine the user interface to make it more intuitive and immersive.
[*] Completely redesign the sound for a more immersive auditory experience.
[*] Further improve microphone calibration and implementation.
[*] Enhance environmental storytelling.
[*] Introduce environmental dangers.
[/list][/quote]
With all that said, we hope you appreciate the direction we’re taking DON’T SCREAM. What started as a UE5 horror experiment is evolving into a richer game experience, thanks to your support. Now, without further ado, here are the patch notes!

[quote][b]PATCH NOTES[/b]
[h3][b]MAJOR CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] Church environment and leading pathways
[*] [b]Added[/b] Sanatorium with extended road to Old Farm House
[*] [b]Added[/b] Cornfield behind Old Farm House
[*] [b]Added[/b] Junkyard with pathways from the Main Road and Abandoned Shack
[*] [b]Added[/b] details to Powerplant
[*] [b]Added[/b] Strange Doors in the forest that now have a purpose
[*] [b]Added[/b] many new details to the enviroments and key locations
[*] [b]Added[/b] fog and more improved lighting to many areas

[*] [b]Modified[/b] lighting and fog in Minimart
[*] [b]Modified[/b] lighting and fog in Cemetery
[*] [b]Modified[/b] Oil Freighter Wreckage scenery 
[*] [b]Modified[/b] water and fog in Swamp 
[*] [b]Modified[/b] Lighting in Old Farm House 

[*] [b]Added[/b] retro-reflective trail markers to help players find their way to key locations
[*] [b]Added[/b] on-screen compass and location to help in finding specific locations
[*] [b]Added[/b] new battery system to force players to keep moving and exploring areas, batteries found at many key locations in the forest
[*] [b]Added[/b] new audio system to allow better control and optimisation of sounds in the world
[*] [b]Added[/b] a few new scares and improved audio on many pre-existing ones

[*] [b]Improved[/b] overall game performance, especially at higher screen resolutions
[*] [b]Improved[/b] collisions of many world props and environment areas to prevent player getting stuck
[/list][/quote]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/N0pI9qI.gif[/img]
[quote]To prevent players from cheating by simply running in circles until the timer runs out, we've introduced batteries to the game. Now, you must find them before your battery completely depletes. We're eager to hear what you think about this![/quote]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZcYyPCJ.gif[/img]
[quote]Why is the Junkyard full of so much trash? What made this specific area a dumping ground?[/quote]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7hz8F6u.gif[/img]
[quote]The Oil Freighter has turned into a complete wreckage. Something terrible happened here. Was it human error, or something far more sinister?[/quote]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/miG2ZKo.gif[/img]
[quote]Why is there a Sanatorium hidden deep in this forest?[/quote]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6H14lP2.gif[/img]
[quote]Yes, we've added a cornfield—because what’s scarier than a cornfield? And who knows, maybe you’ll find a scarecrow lurking somewhere?[/quote]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FqbaELJ.gif[/img]
[quote]We’ve also introduced a church to the environment. Considering the number of people who have vanished or died in this forest, this old church raises some haunting questions.[/quote]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6yXe2Ta.gif[/img]
[quote]Those spooky free-standing doors? They now mysteriously teleport the player to different areas of the forest.[/quote]
These are just a few of the major additions in our latest update. We've also made numerous smaller tweaks, changes, and fixes. For instance, take a look at any of the updated gifs, and you’ll notice we’ve added an on-screen compass and location markers to help players navigate to specific spots. Additionally, we’ve significantly enhanced the audio quality. Ulrich Gollick, our audio engineer and game designer, explains more about these improvements:

[quote][i]"For this update, we've also focussed on establishing the framework for a richer, more immersive soundscape system. This entails ensuring that the audio levels accurately match what is depicted on screen and that players feel deeply immersed in the game world. For example, when entering a house, the soundscape seamlessly transitions from the outdoor ambience to the sounds of wind and outdoor noises filtering in through windows and doors. Additionally, we've incorporated appropriate reverb effects based on the size of each room. If players choose to close the doors, the sound is appropriately muffled or attenuated, enhancing the realism of the experience.

In each area of the game, unique sound elements, which we call 'nuggets,' are implemented. These nuggets are intricately designed to convey a narrative, offering insights into past events or leaving room for further speculation"[/i][/quote]
Keep an eye out for future announcements, and thanks for your ongoing support!

Have a wonderful start to your week! - [b]Joe[/b]

- Digital Cybercherries

notes.title: Major Update #2 | Environment Overhaul - Part 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/d7b03a0148b3274ff9a373187b7ce07c84485d62.png[/img]

[b]Welcome, Screamers![/b]

I'm excited to announce our next major update; [b]Environment Overhaul - Part 1[/b]! We're making great progress on our development roadmap ([b][i]see below[/i])[/b], and right now, we're concentrating on a complete overhaul of the environments. This means we're putting even more focus on environmental storytelling. To explain our goals in more detail, here's our very own [i]Josh Lennen,[/i] who leads the art design for DON'T SCREAM, to share his insights:

[quote][b]Josh Lennen[/b]: In this environment update we wanted to focus on giving players more opportunity to explore.  Instead of players simply getting lost in the woods, we've added more paths and environmental guides to the existing landscape.  More landmarks will be coming in a future update to guide the player, but we've also added entirely new regions, and expanded upon existing regions of the map so they are easy to find.  Our aim is to draw players into each environmental region where we plan to develop future scares, all focused around exploring the storytelling of each region.  This is just the start of the process for us in our small dev team, and with our planned roadmap for future updates, there will be more detail and new regions added to take the player deeper into the experience of Don't Scream. [/quote]
Thanks, Josh! Just to build on what Josh mentioned, I want to highlight that we've really focused on the finer details to enhance the game's realism. Take the plane crash site as an example, it now represents more closely what you'd typically expect from a crash scene. We've added damaged terrain, shattered trees, and much more to enhance the experience. Our aim is to increase your curiosity about what happened in this forest!

We're excited to keep improving the game and hearing what you think, this is only just the start! It's a step-by-step process – we'll try things out, see what fits and what doesn't, and keep refining. Our goal is to offer you an even more complete horror experience. I also want to note that we haven't updated the scares yet. The next few major updates will heavily focus on the environment. As we hit each milestone on our development roadmap, we'll then shift focus to other elements of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2497900/DONT_SCREAM/

If you come across any bugs, please report them on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2497900/discussions/2/]Steam Forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/TGBR58KPjB]Discord[/url] if you encounter any bugs. Thank you!

notes.title: Major Update #1 | Performance Improvements + Dev Roadmap
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Screamers![/b]

Firstly, thank you for your incredible support for "DON'T SCREAM". This journey has been beyond our wildest expectations. When we launched this game as a short UE5 horror experience, we never imagined it would capture your attention the way it has. Your enthusiasm and ideas have not only been inspiring but have also highlighted the potential for even greater depth in the game.

As much as we've achieved, Joure and I are aware of the limits of what we can accomplish alone, particularly regarding content and technical enhancements. We're proud of the improvements we've made so far, yet we recognize that there's a broader scope for development. This was a challenging realization, especially as our initial vision was for a short, engaging horror experience built-in UE5.

After careful consideration, and with the above in mind, Joure and I have decided to pursue different paths to best utilize our individual talents and visions. Joure will be moving on to new projects, beginning his own adventure in the indie dev scene. I wholeheartedly support him and thank him for his dedication and remarkable contributions to DON'T SCREAM. You can continue to support and follow his future endeavours on his [url=https://discord.com/invite/XVgHZdx8fp]Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.patreon.com/Joure/posts]Patreon[/url] platforms. Thank you, Joure! 

As for me, I will remain actively involved with DON'T SCREAM, now with additional help. I'm excited to announce a collaboration with Digital Cybercherries. They will come on board to help develop and publish the game. This partnership marks a new chapter in the game's journey, promising to improve and expand the gameplay experience, overcoming the technical limitations that once hindered us. So, it's time to talk about the first major update and the future of DON'T SCREAM.

Please let us know on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2497900/discussions/2/]Steam Forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/TGBR58KPjB]Discord[/url] if you encounter any bugs. Thank you![url=https://discord.com/invite/TGBR58KPjB][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/1f980cfbe5ef8dc8e1511f846f10dde1e4100a68.png[/img]
[/url]
[h3]WHAT LIES AHEAD FOR DON'T SCREAM[/h3]
Over the past two months since the launch of DON'T SCREAM, we've learned that you all really love the concept of the game. However, you've told us that its execution could be better. We've spent these months analyzing your feedback and identifying the most common points of interest. The most common feedback focused on performance, better microphone calibration, an improved user interface, and more subtle, tension-based scares instead of too many abrupt jump scares. There was also a desire for more backstory and lore, explaining why you're exploring the forest and understanding your purpose there. Many comments also suggested adding other dangers in the forest, which can kill the player if not cautiously avoided. Additionally, we noticed requests for objectives to motivate players to delve deeper into the forest's mysteries.

With this in mind, and with the assistance of Digital Cybercherries, we're now confident that we can implement the following improvements and content throughout 2024, each with more significant polish:

Here's our development roadmap for the enhancements and additions we plan to make in 2024, based on your ongoing feedback: ([i]click the image to enlarge[/i]).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/2190b67586bbc7b7954e379397b44e564d6bd3f8.png[/img]If the image won't open, here's a text version:

[quote][b]DON'T SCREAM DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP 2024[/b]

[h3]OPTIMIZATION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Vastly improve performance for lower-end systems to ensure smoother gameplay, while further optimizing medium and high graphics settings.  
[*] Ensure consistent performance across all platforms, potentially including VR and consoles.  
[*] Optimize 3D models and textures to enhance performance without sacrificing detail.
[b]And more...[/b]
[/list]
[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] A more user-friendly and intuitive user interface. 
[*] Scarier scares with a focus on tension and buildup of atmosphere. Less “in your face” jump scares, more creative ones.
[*] Redesign of the entire sound for more immersive sound experience 
[*] Improved microphone calibration and implementation.
[b]And more...[/b]
[/list]
[h3]STORY / OBJECTIVES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced environmental storytelling.
[*] Introduction of objectives. Not only is the main goal to last 18 minutes without screaming, but soon you must also complete objectives to beat the game. 
[*] A deeper focus on lore and background story.
[*]We're considering adding new threats to the game, like enemies that can chase, stalk, and kill the player if not carefully avoided. These enhancements aim to increase the game's suspense and challenge.
[b]And more...[/b]
[/list]
[/quote]
[h3]WHAT’S NEW IN MAJOR UPDATE #1?[/h3]
We are thrilled to announce our first major update, developed with the expertise of Digital Cybercherries. The update significantly enhances performance on lower-end systems, making 'DON’T SCREAM' more accessible to players with less powerful PCs. This is a crucial step in our ongoing efforts to optimize the game. [i]Key improvements include:[/i]

[b]Enhanced Performance for Low-End Systems:[/b]
Players with lower-spec PCs can now enjoy a smoother gaming experience. This update marks our commitment to making the game more accessible and enjoyable for a broader audience.

[b]Progress in Optimization:[/b]
While the game is better optimized for medium and high settings, we are still refining these aspects. The most noticeable performance upgrades in this update are on low-graphics settings.

[b]Reduced Loading Times and Cleaner Assets:[/b]
We've significantly cut down loading times and streamlined game assets and textures. This results in a cleaner, more efficient gaming experience.

[b]Players Can Now Run Much Faster with "Sprint":[/b]
We have significantly increased the sprint movement speed. This speed is not final, as we are testing to find the optimal balance for gameplay.

As we continue our journey toward full release, we are excited to further improve, optimize, and add more content to the game, thanks to your feedback. 

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued support! Have a wonderful festive season ahead! - [b]Joe[/b]

- Digital Cybercherries

notes.title: Settings Update (Part 1)
notes.content:
DON'T SCREAM has gotten a settings / setup overhaul.

With this update you'll be able to:

- Change resolution
- Set a windowed mode
- Toggle VSync
- Cap the game's FPS
- And a new "medium" quality option has been added

There's now also a better Microphone settings page where you can change the default mic and set the value. It also detects if it's muted and you can un-tick it from there too.

With that said we will keep improving the settings and will be adding Audio options and a proper key-binding function soon!

We also identified the issue where your mic isn't picked up (Microphone privacy). It's a bit of an elusive issue that spans across Windows 10 and 11 users. We'll do our best to provide a solution once we can!

notes.title: BEFORE YOU BUY!
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/TGBR58KPjB][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/dfdd56b7ae2e3a064d99fdc46fcadcf6bcddbe2f.png[/img][/url]

[b]BEFORE YOU BUY![/b]

Hello everyone! It's Joure and Joe here. As two indie developers, we value transparency and want you to be fully informed before you decide to buy our game. So, here are some things you should know about DON’T SCREAM:

[h3][b]WHO ARE WE?[/b][/h3] We're just two indie devs pouring our heart and soul into this game. We're not a big corporation, just two passionate gamers like you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/48bbe8dcc2b9b3114d143a6f6cc53cb613285ec1.png[/img]

[h3][b]WHAT IS DON'T SCREAM?[/b][/h3] At its core, think of DON'T SCREAM as a scare simulator - but not just any simulator. It's pretty terrifying and perfect for scaring the pants off your friends and family! However, that doesn't mean that we won't expand upon the gameplay and make it into something more. During our Early Access phase, we'll actively listen to your feedback to enhance the game and plan on adding the following:

• New and Dynamic Scares (focusing on pure "tension" building)
• Expansion of Game Lore
• Optional Objectives ([i]learn more about Pineview Forest[/i])
• Steam Achievements
• Steam Trading Cards
• Localization Support
• Full Controller Support
• New Landmarks and Structures in the Forest
• Game Optimization 
• Additional Settings Options
• And more

We have so many ideas and improvements for the game, this is only the beginning!

[h3][b]HOW MUCH IS DON'T SCREAM?[/b][/h3]
We recognize that times are challenging right now. Everyone is doing their best to save money, and we want as many people as possible to enjoy DON'T SCREAM. That's why we've set the Early Access price at approximately $9 USD. However, the final price may vary based on player feedback and the introduction of additional content to the game.

[h3][b]BUGS[/b][/h3]
Remember, playing DON'T SCREAM during Early Access will come with some bugs and rough edges. This isn't the final version. By joining us now, you're not just playing early; you're helping us make it better.

[h3][b]MICROPHONE NEEDED[/b][/h3] DON’T SCREAM requires a microphone to play. While you can bypass this, where's the fun in that?

[h3][b]HEADSET/HEADPHONES RECOMMENDED[/b][/h3]
 For the best experience, we suggest using a headset.

[h3][b]GAME LORE[/b][/h3] While DON’T SCREAM doesn't have a traditional story mode, it's filled with hidden lore for those eager to dive deeper. We want you to learn more about Pineview Forest, and as stated above, we plan to add much more story/lore to the game!

[h3][b]UNREAL ENGINE 5[/b][/h3] We harnessed the power of Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a stunning VHS aesthetic. However, achieving this aesthetic has its trade-offs with performance. We're constantly working on optimization, but there are limits to performance enhancements without compromising the artistic and visual fidelity we've envisioned. Below are our minimum and recommended specs:

[b]MINIMUM:[/b]
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 ／ Processor Intel i5 9600K
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia 1660 Super 6 GB / 5600 XT 8 GB
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 12 GB available space
Additional Notes: Microphone Required - Headset + SSD Highly Recommended

[b]RECOMMENDED:[/b]
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 11 (64 bit)
Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X ／ Intel Core i5-12600K 
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12 GB / RX 6700 XT GAMING 12GB
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 12 GB available space
Additional Notes: Microphone Required - Headset + SSD Highly Recommended

[b]Please note:[/b] We've tested DON'T SCREAM on low-spec PCs, and it does run smoothly. However, due to the demanding nature of Unreal Engine 5, the frame rates might not be sky-high. That said, keep in mind this isn't a fast-paced first-person shooter. You don't need a super high fps count to enjoy our game. As you wander and immerse yourself in the scares, even modest, smooth frame rates will do the trick!

[h3][b][/b][/h3]
[h3][h3][b]PLAY AS INTENDED[/b][/h3][/h3] Before playing DON’T SCREAM; please play the game as we intended – this means setting up your microphone correctly. Here’s how to do that. You should only speak quietly, not loudly, with slight gasps or sudden noises counting as screams. This is designed to enhance the challenge and horror atmosphere of the game. If you speak too loudly and your voice exceeds the threshold of the microphone divider line, a red flash will appear on the screen, signalling a scream. 

It's up to you to find a comfortable balance between speaking softly and what should be considered a scream when you calibrate your microphone. You should determine the best distance to position the microphone from your mouth for optimal results. Please be aware that external audio software can impact your game's microphone calibration, so please check your software settings if issues arise. Adjust settings in both your game and audio software for optimal calibration. 

[previewyoutube=ZgDsVA4koOY;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for considering our game. We genuinely appreciate all of you!

- Joure, Joe, and Teddy!

notes.title: DON'T SCREAM - Official Gameplay Reveal
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5sGY8Cw2nk0;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://discord.gg/nC3w5pkH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694809/dfdd56b7ae2e3a064d99fdc46fcadcf6bcddbe2f.png[/img][/url]

[h3][url=https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/zsm37m75g6oxqttzrv2f9/h?rlkey=pwvyrpyxb7orp0mou2mstl5fz&dl=0]PRESS KIT[/url][/h3]

This is a short horror experience designed to make players jump. Think of it as a scare simulator. Don't expect a storyline; just one primary challenge: DON'T SCREAM. It's simple enough for anyone, even your mom. Seriously, challenge your mom to play!

If you scream, you restart. DON’T SCREAM is an Unreal Engine 5 short horror experience inspired by '90s camcorder found footage. Made by two indie devs. The challenge is simple: explore the mysterious Pineview Forest for 18 minutes without screaming.

Sounds easy, right? But there's a catch. Time only progresses as you move, and you cannot predict the scares. You must calibrate your microphone in-game so that every whimper, jump, or even a minor squeak is registered as a scream, increasing the challenge. With dozens of dynamic scares, each playthrough offers a unique experience.

It’s the perfect game to scare the pants off your friends and family. Our lead playtester (also my wife) is currently in a clinic recovering.

[h2][b][u]MICROPHONE REQUIRED TO PLAY[/u][/b][/h2]
DON'T SCREAM challenges not just your nerves but your voice control. Here's what to expect:

[h2][b]1. Calibrate Your Microphone:[/b][/h2]
Set it up in-game. It's not just tech setup; it defines your challenge. A mere squeak or quiet gasp should be flagged as a scream, causing you to restart.
[h2][b]2. Mind Your Voice:[/b][/h2]
You can talk during gameplay, but keep it low – slightly softer than normal. Too loud and it’s game over.

[h2][b]3. Play Fair:[/b][/h2]
You could bypass calibration to shout through scares, but it'd spoil the thrill. For a genuine horror experience play as designed.


DISCLAIMER: WE ACCEPT NO RESPONSIBILITY FOR ANY UNDERWEAR THAT MAY BECOME UNUSABLE SHOULD YOU PLAY OUR GAME.



[h2]When will the game come out?[/h2]
DONT SCREAM enters early access on October the 27th, 2023 - in time for Halloween!

[h2]Do I need a good PC for DONT SCREAM?[/h2]
We utilize Unreal Engine 5 to maximize the game's visual fidelity. While we've made significant optimization efforts and continue to do so, below are our minimum and recommended system specifications.

[h2]How long is the game?[/h2]
'DONT SCREAM' is designed as an 18-minute horror experience. However, the actual duration can vary depending on how often you get scared and scream, prompting restarts. With multiple scares to encounter, the replayability value is high.

[h2]Are there Spiders in the game?[/h2]
Yes, 'DONT SCREAM' does feature spiders. If you suffer from arachnophobia, please exercise caution before playing.

[h2]How do you plan on improving the game?[/h2]
During our Early Access phase, we'll actively listen to players' feedback to enhance the game. For 'DONT SCREAM', we aim to increase the scare factor by adding new surprises and more mysterious elements in the environment. Our goal is to make the game both more enjoyable and scary.

[h2]Why VHS?[/h2]
We love the raw look of camcorders. The grainy effects make the horror even more intense. It makes you wonder: Did I really see something scary far away, or was it just the camera playing tricks on me

[h2]Is there a storyline?[/h2]
While 'DONT SCREAM' doesn't follow a traditional storyline, it does immerse players in the lore of Pineview Forest. This fictional forest brims with mysteries and oddities. If the game gains popularity, we're considering delving further into this lore.

[h2]What is the objective?[/h2]
The main goal is to explore Pineview Forest without screaming. In the full version, we plan to introduce Steam achievements that will reward you for uncovering the mysteries of Pineview forest. Depending on how well the game is received, we might add more optional objectives.

[h2]Do I need a microphone to play?[/h2]
Yes, you do.
